verdict.rationale: Stable offers some event-driven automation — auto-routing mail based on keywords, configurable Slack/email notifications, AI-based sorting, and webhooks that fire on account events — which are rule-like triggers/actions tied to mail events. However, there's no evidence of a general user-definable rules engine (e.g., custom trigger+action builder) beyond these preset automation features and outbound webhooks. Missing for 10: a documented custom rule/condition builder, support for arbitrary user-defined triggers beyond mail keywords, and evidence of inbound automation triggered by webhooks (e.g., API-driven reactions).
